Description: Computer-use questions from the Eugene-Springfield Community Sample, answered as one of up to twelve unlabelled categories (A-L). 709 respondents x 2 items = 1388 responses; categories A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L.
Reference: Goldberg, L. R. (2018). Eugene-Springfield Community Sample, (27) Skills, Possessions, and Abilities [Data set]. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/IOA6EE
Notes: Thin: only two items, and the collection ships no key for the category labels.

Description: Which multiple-choice option (A-D) each South African grade-4 learner selected on the four MC items of the PIRLS 2023 'Octopuses' reading passage. 1680 respondents x 4 items = 5486 responses; categories A/B/C/D.
Reference: Mthimkhulu, S., Roux, K., & Mihai, M. (2023). Progress in International Reading Literacy (PIRLS) 2023 English and isiZulu achievement [Data set]. University of Pretoria. https://doi.org/10.25403/UPresearchdata.24784086
Notes: Complements the scored core table mthimkhulu_2023_pirls_reading, which scores these items 1/0 against the key; this table preserves which distractor was chosen.
